requirements.installation: Install the Python requirements and run the reference driver or panel tester. Close Resolve first to avoid competing writes to the panel.

evidence.note: Maintainer reports Windows 11 USB/Bluetooth tests on one physical panel. Linux and macOS notes are explicitly untested.
Python 3 and hidapi are required; close Resolve first and retain the stock Windows HID driver.
Python reference driver communicates with the local panel through HID; no Resolve-hosted plugin is installed.
hidapi>=0.14. A physical Micro Color Panel is needed for real input; optional tester demo mode is not a hardware test.
CC0-1.0 public-domain dedication for code, protocol documentation and logs. No upstream logs are copied into the catalogue.
Source commit, not a published software version.

Documents the Micro Color Panel USB/Bluetooth protocol and provides a Python reference driver and live panel tester for use outside Resolve. Requires the physical panel, Python 3 and hidapi. The maintainer reports Windows 11 tests on one panel; macOS and Linux notes remain untested. MIDI/OSC and photo-editor backends are not included.
